body::after { content: ''; position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100vh; pointer-events: none; z-index: 9999; animation: forgePulse 1.2s infinite alternate !important; mix-blend-mode: screen; } @keyframes forgePulse { 0% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(255, 100, 0, 0.1); } 100% { box-shadow: inset 0 0 150px rgba(255, 80, 0, 0.4); } }
